items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: No, I knew Bernard. He was a trumpet player. Oh Man Bernard.

ctx.x: Who was in Oh Man Bernard's orchestra?

I know Adolf Rooney was a drummer. Paul Muglia was playing. I remember playing trumpet or something like that. I know Paul Muglia used to play trumpet. But no, I was Paul Muglia. I couldn't remember. What was Bernard's name? Did you know? No, I knew Bernard. He was a trumpet player. Oh Man Bernard. Oh Man. Oh Man Bernard.
